# BB00296 {.unnumbered}

In the Name of God, the All-Illumined, the All-Originating, the Transcendent, the All-Glorious.

Unto God belongeth the splendor of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with a splendour tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the radiance of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with a radiance tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the exaltation of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with an exaltation tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the effulgence of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with an effulgence tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the bounty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with a bounty tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the beauty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with a beauty and a majesty tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the majesty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with a majesty and a beauty tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the effectual working of Truth in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with a working tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the unassailable might of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with a might, exalted, tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the liberal bestowal of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with a bounty, exalted, tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the whole of mercy, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been endowed with a mercy tremendous.

Unto God belongeth honour in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with an honour tremendous.

Unto God belongeth all might in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with a might tremendous.

Unto God belongeth all power, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been endowed with a power tremendous.

Unto God belongeth all sovereignty, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been endowed with a sovereignty tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the Exposition of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with an exposition tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the good-pleasure (ridwan) of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with a good-pleasure tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the forgiveness of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with a forgiveness tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the Criterion (furqan) of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with a criterion tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the Qur'an of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with a Recitation tremendous.

Unto God belong the signs of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with signs tremendous.

Unto God belong the words of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with words tremendous.

Unto God belong the manifestations of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with a manifestation tremendous.

Unto God belong the modes and dispositions of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with a mode tremendous.

Unto God belong the tokens and evidences of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with evidences tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the ruby treasure of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with a ruby treasure tremendous.

Unto God belong the inmost essences and jewels of the entire Cause, in the Kingdom of command and creation, for every soul according to what it can bear; and God hath ever been endowed with a sovereignty tremendous.

Unto God belongeth the realm of Divinity (lahut) of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with a Divinity tremendous. Unto God belongeth the realm of Might (jabarut) of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with a Might tremendous. Unto God belongeth the Kingdom (malakut) of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been endowed with a Kingdom tremendous.

In the Name of God, the All-Glorious, the All-Transcending, the All-Majestic, the All-Near.

Unto God appertaineth the whole of the Cause, in the beginning and in the end. He createth whatsoever He willeth through His command, "Be", and it is. He it is Who hath created you according to that which hath been sent down in the Book from His presence, and He, verily, is all-knowing, all-wise.

Unto God prostrateth himself whosoever is in the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever encompassed all things. Unto God belong the East and the West and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever encompassed all things. Unto God belong the lines and courses of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been possessed of a comely, beauteous tracing. Unto God belongeth the splendour of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been possessed of splendour and radiance. Unto God belongeth the majesty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, majestic, majestic. Unto God belongeth the beauty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in very truth, beautiful, beautiful. Unto God belongeth all greatness in the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God hath ever been possessed of greatness and exalted might tremendous.

Unto God appertaineth the whole of the Cause, in the beginning and in the end, and God hath ever been one God, single, alone, peerless, living, self-subsisting, everlasting, all-holy, all-sanctified, One to be feared, One well-beloved, the Goal of all, the Object of all desire, the Praised, the Thanked, the Worshipped, the Seen, the Remembered, the Known.

His is the creation and the command, in the beginning and in the end, and unto Him shall all return.

Say: All are unto Him devoutly obedient. Say: All are unto Him worshippers. Say: All are unto Him prostrate. Say: All are unto Him patient and steadfast. Say: All are unto Him humble and submissive.

Say: Verily, in God I am, over you, a reckoner and a witness. Say: Verily, in God I am, over you, a guardian and a protector. Say: Verily, in God I am, over you, a watcher, potent. Say: Verily, in God I am, over you, mighty, all-glorious. Say: Verily, in God I am, over you, a subduer, manifest. Say: Verily, in God I am, over you, one standing, standing (ever-watchful, unsleeping). Say: Verily, in God I am, over you, exalted, impregnable.

Say: I have put my whole trust in God, my Lord, in the beginning and in the end, and sufficient is God as a Guardian.

Say: I have put my whole trust in God, the Living One, Who createth whatsoever He willeth through His command, "Be", and it is.

And say: Praise be to God, before Whom prostrate themselves whosoever are in the heavens and whosoever are on the earth and whatsoever lieth between them. Then glorify Him, and hallow Him, and magnify Him, and exalt Him with a mighty exaltation.

Unto God belongeth the realm of Divinity (lahut) of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in truth, powerful, powerful. Unto God belongeth the realm of Might (jabarut) of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in truth, majestic, majestic. Unto God belongeth the Kingdom (malakut) of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in truth, radiant, radiant. Unto God belongeth the ruby treasure of God in the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in truth, tremendous, tremendous. Unto God belongeth the realm of the visible world (nasut) of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is, in truth, beautiful, beautiful.

Say: Verily, I shall assuredly draw all things unto Myself through God, for God, the Lord of all the worlds. Say: Verily, I shall assuredly make all things subservient through God, for God, the Lord of all the worlds. Say: Verily, I shall assuredly gain dominion over all things through God, for God, the Lord of all the worlds. Say: Verily, I shall assuredly prevail over all things through God, for God, the Lord of all the worlds. Say: Verily, I shall assuredly lay hold of all things through God, for God, the Lord of all the worlds. Say: Verily, I shall assuredly seek to guide all things aright through God, for God, the Lord of all the worlds.

Say: Verily, I shall assuredly seek victory, through God, over all things, at every time, before time and after time.
